card.text: Explore Ophelia, the outer shepherd of Uranus's epsilon ring.

introduction.text: Ophelia is the outer shepherd of Uranus’s epsilon ring. Together with Cordelia, it helps confine the narrow ring through gravitational resonances.

model.title: Approximate shape model
model.summary: A 54 × 38 × 38 km shape estimate from Voyager. Two axes are assumed equal; gray grid: no surface imagery.
